What is 1password?

1Password stores your passwords, passkeys, credit cards, and other sensitive items in an encrypted vault you unlock with one master password (plus a secret key), then autofills them across your browser, desktop, and phone. Beyond personal password management it has grown into a broader access-security platform, adding features like a password-health dashboard, SaaS app discovery, device-trust checks, and credential management for AI agents and automated workflows.

Install 1password on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add 1password

Good to know

  • a 1Password account (paid subscription) to store and sync vault data
  • network access to sync vaults
